name: Flight 10
summary: Flight 10 launched on its third attempt and was the first Block 2 mission to complete its full profile. Booster 16 ran landing burn experiments, including a planned engine-out case, then hovered and splashed into the Gulf of Mexico. Ship 37 deployed eight Starlink simulators, relit a Raptor in space, and survived reentry despite an explosion that damaged its aft skirt. It made a controlled splashdown northwest of Australia at T+1:06:30, landing within a few meters of its target.
highlights: Ship survived reentry despite aft skirt damage
Splashdown within a few meters of the target

objectives.label: Booster landing burn experiments
objectives.note: One engine lost on ascent; a backup engine stood in during the landing burn.

objectives.label: Ship reentry heat shield tests
objectives.note: Aft skirt and flaps were damaged.

objectives.label: Ship controlled splashdown in the Indian Ocean

payload.name: Starlink mass simulators
payload.description: About 16,000 kg; deployed between T+18:27 and T+25:32.

boosterFate: Planned hover and splashdown in the Gulf of Mexico about 6.9 minutes after launch; exploded on impact.
shipFate: Controlled splashdown in the Indian Ocean northwest of Australia at T+1:06:30; tipped over and exploded.
